title: Price-Coordinated Mean Field Games with State Augmentation for Decentralized Battery Charging
summary: This paper addresses the decentralized coordinated charging problem for a large population of battery storage agents (e.g. residential batteries, electrical vehicles, charging station batteries) using Mean Field Game (MFG). Agents are assumed to have affine dynamics and are coupled through a price that is continuous and monotonically increasing with respect to the difference between the average charging power and the grid's desired average charging power.
